The blocks the binding ground truth (tests/test_binding_ground_truth.py) does NOT cover, each with the exact cause scripts/dump_block_bindings.js --excluded reports and the reason it is out of scope. This replaces an implicit `continue` in the dump: a block that stops binding a formal (or starts) fails the test in BOTH directions, so the covered set cannot shrink or grow unnoticed.
